message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm in the kitchen when I realized I hadn’t checked our smoke alarms in ages. It turned into a fun little scavenger hunt around the house, reminding me of how low-tech can be just as engaging as any gadget. Now we’ve got a kitchen safety routine and a fresh escape plan—who knew being prepared could also mean rediscovering a bit of old-school fun? What’s your favorite way to keep things safe and simple at home? 🏠
